about: The Workbench icons of the CriticalMass drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/criticalmass.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/criticalmass.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. CriticalMass-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, CriticalMass.info beside the program.
